                            <button type="button" class="btn btn-cancel text-blue font-15 mr-4 reset-value-weekly" data-dismiss="modal">
                                Batal
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" class="btn-primary update-deed-weekly" id="buttonUpdateWeekly">
                                <span class="mr-1">Simpan</span>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
